groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.579% and the 10Y at 4.921%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has fallen for 3 consecutive sessions. QQQ is -4.37% over five sessions and -5.98% versus its 20-day average. Brent is -0.73% at about $102.84, providing some inflation relief.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-27/100, 67% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is falling oil on the supportive side versus semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs, rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
